note: Triennial election of Irvinestown Rural District Council, nineteen divisions, one member each. There was no contest: the Impartial Reporter of 7 May 1936, p. 7, prints the nominations received the previous week ('In the Irvinestown Rural District there will be no contests. The following candidates, comprising 11 Unionists and eight Nationalists, have been returned unopposed') with every division and member. Filed on 1936-06-03, the county's polling day that year (provisional; the count was on Thursday 4 June, Impartial Reporter 11 June 1936, p. 5). Returned unopposed.
